**What is MSME Udyam Registration?**  MSME registration is also called Udyam registration. The entities that fulfil the MSME classification can apply for MSME registration from the government portal, the Udyam portal. The MSME registration is entirely online and can be obtained from the Udyam registration portal. It is not mandatory for MSMEs to obtain this registration, but it is beneficial to get one\\\\u2019s business registered under this because it provides a lot of benefits in terms of taxation, setting up the business, credit facilities, loans etc.  Over 1 crore registered MSMEs, employing 7.5 crore people, contribute 36% to India\\'s manufacturing and 45% to exports, establishing the country as a global manufacturing hub with their high-quality products.  #, **MSME Registration Eligibility**  **All manufacturing, service industries, wholesale, and retail trade that fulfil the revised MSME classification criteria of annual turnover and investment can apply for MSME registration.**\\\\u00a0Thus, the MSME registration eligibility depends on an entity\\\\u2019s annual turnover and investment. The following entities are eligible for MSME registration:  1. Individuals, startups, business owners, and entrepreneurs 2. Private and public limited companies 3. Sole proprietorship 4. Partnership firm 5. Limited Liability Partnerships (LLPs) 6. Self Help Groups (SHGs) 7. Co-operative societies 8. Trusts  #, **Documents Required for MSME Registration**  **The MSME registration****documents****are as follows:**  1. **Aadhaar card** 2. **PAN card**  **There are no MSME registration fees**\\\\u00a0and it does not require proof of documents. PAN and GST-linked details on investment and turnover of enterprises will be taken automatically by the Udyam Registration Portal from the Government databases since the portal is integrated with Income Tax and GSTIN systems.  **GST registration is not compulsory**\\\\u00a0**for enterprises that do not require a GST**registration. However, enterprises that mandatorily need to obtain GST registration under the GST law, must enter their GSTIN for obtaining the MSME Registration or\\\\u00a0Udyam Registration.  #, **How to Apply for MSME Registration on Udyam Registration Portal?**  \\\\u00a0**The MSME registration process is entirely online. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. process for applying for E-Waste (Management and Handling) authorization in Gujarat involves the following steps:  ##, 1. **Determine Applicability**  Identify your role in the e-waste lifecycle, such as producer, manufacturer, refurbisher, dismantler, or recycler, to understand your specific obligations under the E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022.  ##, 2. **Prepare Required Documents**  You will need to submit the following:  1. Utilization plan for the processed e-waste  ##, 3. **Submit Application Online**  1. Access the Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP) of the Government of Gujarat. 2. Register or log in to your account. 3. Navigate to the \\'Authorization under E-Waste Management Rules\\' section. 4. Fill in the required details and upload the necessary documents. 5. Pay the applicable fees online.  ##, 4. **Obtain Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Authorization (if applicable)**  1. Producers must register on the Central Pollution Control Board\\'s (CPCB) EPR portal. 2. Provide details such as the quantity of Electrical and Electronic Equipment (EEE) placed on the market and an EPR plan outlining collection and recycling mechanisms. 3. The CPCB will assess the application, and upon approval, issue the EPR authorization.  ##, 5. **Compliance and Reporting**  1. Maintain records of e-waste collected, processed, and disposed of. 2. Submit periodic returns to the GPCB and CPCB as mandated. 3. Ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards during e-waste handling and processing. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Startups availing benefits under other startup schemes of the Government of Gujarat are ineligible.  ##, Application Process  Online   > ***Registration Process:***  **Step 1:** Visit the online portal and click on the \\\\\"Register\\\\\" button, located at the top right corner.  **Step 2:** Enter Email ID and click on Next button. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. The objective is to support industries by improving last-mile connectivity and access to utilities, thereby fostering a conducive business environment.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"><u>Quantum of Assistance:<\\\\/u><\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"ordered\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An enterprise will be eligible for assistance up to 70% of the allotment price of GIDC. <\\\\/span><\\\\/li><li data-list=\\\\\"ordered\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">On payment of 30% of the allotment price, GIDC will hand over the possession of the plot and submit the claim of subsidy up to 70% of the allotment price to the commissioner MSME. <\\\\/span><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Eligibility<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The firm must be a Micro\\\\/Small\\\\/Medium enterprise run by SC\\\\/ST entrepreneur.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The applicant must apply for a plot within an estate approved by GIDC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The maximum plot size should not exceed 1000 Sq. Mt. (with exceptions for irregular plots).<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"><u>Note<\\\\/u>: <\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">SC\\\\/ST Enterprise:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> SC\\\\/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC\\\\/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more. <\\\\/span><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p><br><\\\\/p><\\\\/div>\",\"10\":\"<div class=\\\\\"ql-editor read-mode\\\\\"><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The key objective of the Gujarat Industrial policy 2020 is to encourage R&amp;D and start innovation and entrepreneurship. Hence, the new scheme is being introduced in order to support startups and innovation at different levels of the startup cycle. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Startups availing benefits under other startup schemes of the Government of Gujarat are ineligible.  ##, Application Process  Online   > ***Registration Process:***  **Step 1:** Visit the online portal and click on the \\\\\"Register\\\\\" button, located at the top right corner.  **Step 2:** Enter Email ID and click on Next button. It is not mandatory for MSMEs to obtain this registration, but it is beneficial to get one\\\\u2019s business registered under this because it provides a lot of benefits in terms of taxation, setting up the business, credit facilities, loans etc.  Over 1 crore registered MSMEs, employing 7.5 crore people, contribute 36% to India\\'s manufacturing and 45% to exports, establishing the country as a global manufacturing hub with their high-quality products.  #, **MSME Registration Eligibility**  **All manufacturing, service industries, wholesale, and retail trade that fulfil the revised MSME classification criteria of annual turnover and investment can apply for MSME registration.**\\\\u00a0Thus, the MSME registration eligibility depends on an entity\\\\u2019s annual turnover and investment. Duly filled application form 2. Site map of the facility location 3. Copy of the latest consent order or renewal issued by the Gujarat Pollution Control Board (GPCB) 4. Utilization plan for the processed e-waste  ##, 3. **Submit Application Online**  1. Access the Investor Facilitation Portal (IFP) of the Government of Gujarat. 2. Register or log in to your account. 3. Navigate to the \\'Authorization under E-Waste Management Rules\\' section. 4. Fill in the required details and upload the necessary documents. 5. Pay the applicable fees online.  ##, 4. **Obtain Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) Authorization (if applicable)**  1. Producers must register on the Central Pollution Control Board\\'s (CPCB) EPR portal. 2. Provide details such as the quantity of Electrical and Electronic Equipment (EEE) placed on the market and an EPR plan outlining collection and recycling mechanisms. 3. The CPCB will assess the application, and upon approval, issue the EPR authorization.  ##, 5. **Compliance and Reporting**  1. Maintain records of e-waste collected, processed, and disposed of. 2. Submit periodic returns to the GPCB and CPCB as mandated. 3. Ensure adherence to safety and environmental standards during e-waste handling and processing. (with exceptions for irregular plots).<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"><u>Note<\\\\/u>: <\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><ol><li data-list=\\\\\"bullet\\\\\"><span class=\\\\\"ql-ui\\\\\" contenteditable=\\\\\"false\\\\\"><\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">SC\\\\/ST Enterprise:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> SC\\\\/ST Enterprise means the enterprise in which contribution of SC\\\\/ST entrepreneur is 51% or more. <\\\\/span><\\\\/li><\\\\/ol><p><br><\\\\/p><\\\\/div>\",\"10\":\"<div class=\\\\\"ql-editor read-mode\\\\\"><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The key objective of the Gujarat Industrial policy 2020 is to encourage R&amp;D and start innovation and entrepreneurship. Hence, the new scheme is being introduced in order to support startups and innovation at different levels of the startup cycle. In view of the strategy under Gujarat Industrial Policy, the Government is pleased to introduce a \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Startups \\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" which will come into force from 07\\\\/08\\\\/2020 and will remain in operation for a period of 5 years, i.e. upto 06.08.2025. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The scheme aims to give a further thrust to promoting startups and strengthening the ecosystem in the state, a task force comprised of leading stakeholders in the Gujarat startup ecosystem. Gujarat, owing to its inherent strength of widespread entrepreneurial spirit has gained a significant spot in the national startup ecosystem. The incentives to Startups under the Gujarat Industrial Policy 2015 have supported in the creation of a strong network of nodal institutions and several startups have expanded their operations\\\\/ products both at the national and international levels.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The Quantum of Assistance as under would be provided to the Startups whose innovative project is approved\\\\/sanctioned by SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Sustenance Allowance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">A sustenance allowance of \\\\u20b9 20,000 per month per startup will be provided to the Startups for a period of one year.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">If startups have at least one woman co-founder, \\\\u20b9 25,000 per month per startup will be provided as a sustenance allowance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Seed support up to \\\\u20b9 30,00,000 will be provided to the Startups on the following, based on approval\\\\/ sanction by SLEC:<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Cost of raw materials\\\\/consumables\\\\/hardware &amp; software\\\\/professional services \\\\/other equipment\\\\/ tools required for prototype\\\\/product\\\\/process development<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Market research Testing &amp; Trials<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">3. Marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance: Here marketing\\\\/ publicity assistance covers assistance to startups to attend national\\\\/international events. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible under this head. <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">[<\\\\/span><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Note:<\\\\/strong><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered for assistance]<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to Startups having a Significant Impact on Society:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Additional support of upto \\\\u20b9 10,00,000 assistance will be provided to startups having innovative projects which have a significant impact on society, based on the conditions on approval\\\\/ sanction given by the SLEC.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Pre-Series A funding:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">In the life cycle of a Startup, there is a funding gap which is better identified as the valley of death. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program. The fees\\\\/charges paid for attending the same will be considered eligible for getting assistance. However, it is clarified that to and fro conveyance\\\\/accommodation expenses will not be considered under this assistance.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">An acceleration program is typically a 3-4 month program for startups at the early traction and scaling stage. It is a process of intense, rapid, and immersive education aimed at accelerating the growth of the startup.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance for Skill Development:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Approved\\\\/sanctioned startups shall be provided assistance for skill development training specific to soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills for the startup project. Financial assistance up to Rs. 1 lakh per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be given for participating in such skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><h4><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to the Approved\\\\/Sanctioned Nodal Institution<\\\\/strong><\\\\/h4><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\"> <\\\\/span><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Mentoring Assistance of \\\\u20b9 1,00,000 per approved\\\\/sanctioned startup shall be provided to Nodal institution for the mentoring service (Maximum \\\\u20b9 15,00,000 per annum per institute.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement Expenses on Organizing Promotional Events:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Reimbursement of 75% of expenses incurred for organizing promotional events to the extent of a maximum \\\\u20b9 5,00,000. However, it is clarified that the beneficiary Nodal Institution will not be eligible to get assistance under any other scheme of Govt. of Gujarat for the same component\\\\/purpose.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Other Support:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">1. Laboratories\\\\/ SDCs (GIDC) \\\\/ Center of Excellence \\\\/ PSUs to support and facilitate innovative ideas\\\\/concepts.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">2. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Startups availing benefits under other startup schemes of the Government of Gujarat are ineligible.  ##, Application Process  Online   > ***Registration Process:***  **Step 1:** Visit the online portal and click on the \\\\\"Register\\\\\" button, located at the top right corner.  **Step 2:** Enter Email ID and click on Next button. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. Startups availing benefits under other startup schemes of the Government of Gujarat are ineligible.  ##, Application Process  Online   > ***Registration Process:***  **Step 1:** Visit the online portal and click on the \\\\\"Register\\\\\" button, located at the top right corner.  **Step 2:** Enter Email ID and click on Next button. Details  The \\\\\"Scheme for Assistance for Start Ups\\\\/ Innovation\\\\\" is an umbrella scheme launched by the Industries and Mines Department, Gujarat under the Gujarat Industrial Policy. Effective from August 7th, 2020 to August 6th, 2025, it aims to drive economic growth by generating jobs, fostering competition, and introducing next-gen solutions.  The component \\\\\"Assistance for Skill Development\\\\\" provides financial support for startups to participate in training programs designed to enhance their soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financial skills. This initiative aims to enable startups to better understand the ecosystem, raise funds, commercialize their ideas, and scale up their projects.  ##, Benefits  1. **Financial Assistance:** Startups can receive up to \\\\u20b91,00,000\\\\/- for skill development training programs on a reimbursement basis. 2. **Skill Enhancement:** Focused training to improve soft skills, managerial skills, marketing skills, and financing skills.  ##, Eligibility  1. Any individual or group of individuals with an innovative idea or concept, recommended by an approved Nodal Institution, is eligible. 2. The scheme is open to startups in any sector or branch of science, technology, engineering, agriculture, healthcare, etc., making it sector-agnostic.   > ***Note:*** *Startups availing benefits under the Student Startup and Innovation Policy (SSIP) are also eligible.*  ##, Exclusions  1. Entities formed by splitting or restructuring an existing business are not considered startups under this scheme. 2. This is a phase post commercialization where the Startup has just started generating revenue till the time period where its product\\\\/service gets market traction. Such startups will be assisted in getting venture capital. Initially, to support, such mid-level Pre-series A funding to startups, a separate fund shall be created under Gujarat Venture Finance Limited (GVFL). This assistance will be specifically to cater to the startups that have already received seed support from the government under various schemes for the promotion of startups.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Interest subsidy:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">The startups that have been approved\\\\/sanctioned under this scheme will be eligible to avail of an additional interest subsidy of 1%, a maximum of up to 9% on term loans under the provisions of the scheme for assistance to MSMEs.<\\\\/span><\\\\/p><p><br><\\\\/p><blockquote><strong style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance to enroll and participate in Acceleration Program:<\\\\/strong><\\\\/blockquote><p><span style=\\\\\"color: rgb(255, 255, 255);\\\\\">Assistance up to \\\\u20b9 3,00,000 per startup will be provided to enroll and participate in the national \\\\/ internationally recognized acceleration program.
